1.explanation:
1. packages/components/src/components/button/button.config.js: This file defines the Storybook variants and default height/context for all buttons. To introduce an expressive 48px-tall button with 16px label text, new variants (e.g. `expressive`, `expressive--field`, `expressive--small`) must be declared here with the correct context flags (size: 'md'/'field'/etc.) and token settings.

2. packages/components/src/components/list/list.config.js: This file enumerates the List variants (ordered/unordered). To add the expressive List style (16px, 24px, zero indent), a new variant entry must be added here with the Digital spec context (type: 'expressive', displayType: 'Expressive', etc.).

3. packages/react/src/components/Button/Button.js: This React component maps props (`size`, `kind`, etc.) to CSS classes (`prefix--btn--md`, `prefix--btn--xl`, etc.). To support the new expressive variant, the `Button` function needs to recognize a new `size` or `kind` token (e.g. `expressive`) and apply the right class (which will trigger the 48px height and 16px font).

4. packages/react/src/components/UnorderedList/UnorderedList.js: This component renders `<ul>` with Carbon list classes. To implement the expressive list dimensions (body-long-02, 24px line height, 0px padding/indent), `UnorderedList` must accept a new prop or className modifier (e.g. `prefix--list--expressive`) and output the correct CSS class so that the expressive token values are applied.
1.bug_scenario: The IBM.com Carbon theme currently only supports the smaller “expressive” defaults (14px text, 18px line-height on lists; 14px button labels with _lg_ = 40px / _xl_ = 48px heights). The design team needs to add “expressive” List and Button variants that match their digital spec: 16px body-long-02 text with 24px line-height (and zero list-item indent), and 16px button labels with a fixed 48px button height across all variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost, danger). The provided images show the Carbon defaults on the right vs. the new Digital spec on the left.

2.explanation:
• button.config.js and list.config.js define the available variants and token contexts for Storybook and CSS generation; they must be updated to include the new expressive variants (48px height/16px font for buttons and 16px/24px list styles with body-long-02).  
• The Button component in Button.js applies size-to-class mappings and pulls in spacing tokens; it needs logic to recognize the new expressive size (e.g. a new size prop or flag) and render the correct CSS class.  
• The UnorderedList component in UnorderedList.js (and similarly any OrderedList) applies hard-coded classnames for the default sizes; it must be modified to support the expressive typographic scale and spacing tokens specified in the new design.
2.bug_scenario: The images compare the new "expressive" button and list designs (16px label size, 48px button height, 16px / 24px list type scale, use of body-long-02 token) against the existing Carbon defaults (14px / 18px for buttons and lists). The bug is that Carbon’s current Button and List components and their configuration don’t expose the new sizes and spacing tokens needed to support the expressive variants for IBM.com.
